narrative.overview: The page is a recruiter's brief for an Applied AI engineer. The first screen has to do two things: make the claim (agentic systems, on ten years of production cloud and IoT) and offer the resume. Everything after that is evidence, in the order a hiring manager can check.
keyCharacteristics: One paper ground, one ink, one accent. The accent is a link, a focus ring, or the path through a diagram.
Type does the hierarchy. Newsreader for the claim, Geist for the prose, JetBrains Mono for indexes, dates, and the stack.
Sections are rows and rules, not cards. Vertical rhythm changes from section to section.
Motion is a short fade on the way in, and one drawn path on the Sherpa diagram. Nothing moves if the reader has asked for reduced motion.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Accent #1B3A6B appears on links, focus rings, and the key path of a diagram. It is not a background, a heading, or a decoration.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Newsreader carries headlines. Geist carries sentences. JetBrains Mono carries anything that is an index, a date, a technology, or a control label. Mono is not a texture for ordinary prose.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: There is no shadow, no glow, and no blur. Depth is a hairline or a change of type. Focus is a 2px accent outline, offset 3px, and that is the only lift an interactive element gets.

dos: Keep every sentence traceable to the CV. If a number is not in the CV, it is not on the page.
Keep the resume control above the fold at 1440×900 and at 390×844.
donts: Don't put the phone number on the page.
Don't claim an IEEE paper, RFC authorship, a JLL GPT, an MCP server, vLLM, BM25, shipped RAG, or a Sherpa metric.
Don't add cards, icon rows, gradients, glow, glass, or skill bars.
Don't render a placeholder for the public repository. The slot stays empty until a repo is cleared.
